# hubspot_pipeline (Data Source)

Looks up a CRM pipeline by object type and pipeline ID, exposing its stages (sorted by display order). Unlike the resource, all stage metadata keys HubSpot returns are shown as-is. Requires the `crm.pipelines.read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up HubSpot's built-in default deal pipeline and its stages without
# managing it. Useful for referencing a stage_id elsewhere in configuration.
data "hubspot_pipeline" "default_deals" {
  object_type = "deals"
  pipeline_id = "default"
}

# The stage_id of the "Closed Won" stage, resolved by label.
locals {
  closed_won_stage_id = one([
    for s in data.hubspot_pipeline.default_deals.stages : s.stage_id
    if s.label == "Closed Won"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_type` (String) CRM object type the pipeline belongs to: `deals`, `tickets`, or a custom object type ID.
- `pipeline_id` (String) The pipeline's ID (e.g. `default` for HubSpot's built-in pipeline).

### Read-Only

- `display_order` (Number) Position of the pipeline relative to other pipelines.
- `id` (String) Identifier for the data source (`{object_type}/{pipeline_id}`).
- `label` (String) Human-readable pipeline label.
- `stages` (Attributes List) The pipeline's stages, ordered by display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stages))

<a id="nestedatt--stages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stages`

Read-Only:

- `display_order` (Number) Position of the stage within the pipeline.
- `label` (String) Human-readable stage label.
- `metadata` (Map of String) All stage metadata keys returned by HubSpot (e.g. `probability`, `isClosed`, `ticketState`).
- `stage_id` (String) Internal stage ID.
